criteria.deficiency: Caveat 1: click ranges differ from the reference. reference.diff:642-643 computes (label_cell_cursor - lpad, label_cell_cursor + len + rpad). For the first 'Home' tab with padding 1, that is (5,11) rather than the tab's own cells (0,6). The candidate's tabs.py:152 (x, selection_end) covers the whole tab. I read the candidate's version as the intended behavior, but it is not the reference's literal output. Caveat 2: the candidate's on_key docstring (tabs.py:328-329) says application bindings still receive the key. But on_key calls event.prevent_default() on every key (tabs.py:346). base message_pump.py:238 stops dispatch once _no_default_action is set, and App's bindings run only from App.on_key -> press (app.py:661-662). Keys forwarded to the focused widget default to allow_forward=True (binding.py:16), so app bindings are skipped while Tabs has focus. The reference does the same (reference.diff:743, 757), so this is shared behavior, but the candidate's docstring claim is wrong. Not verified by execution.
